title: CLI Cargo manifest contains real merge conflict markers
description: The manifest conflicts between dependency sets: one branch keeps keyring, tokio-tungstenite, linux seccomp/libc, and insta; the other keeps only the Unix nix target dependency and drops insta.
impact: Cargo.toml is invalid TOML, so cargo metadata, cargo check, CLI builds, and CLI tests fail before Rust compilation starts.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed standard conflict markers in apps/cli/Cargo.toml around dependencies and dev-dependencies.
recommendation: Resolve the dependency conflict explicitly, then run cargo metadata and cargo check before continuing CLI work.

title: sessions.rs has duplicated atomic_write and DirLock definitions
description: The file has no conflict markers, but atomic_write, DirLock, and impl DirLock are duplicated in two blocks.
impact: Once the manifest parses, Rust compilation should fail with duplicate definition errors. It also indicates a partial or incorrect merge resolution in session persistence code.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit found duplicate helper blocks at lines 22/43/48 and 86/107/112.
recommendation: Line-audit both copies, keep the intended implementation once, and add a compile gate to catch duplicate merge artifacts.

title: OpenAI provider contains parser-breaking merge conflicts
description: The file conflicts between unified @agiworkforce/llm-runtime classifyError handling and local status-based retryability handling. It also imports parseRetryAfterFromError from two places.
impact: TypeScript parsing/build fails immediately. After marker removal, duplicate imports and retry semantics still need resolution.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict markers around streaming error handling and retry-after classification.
recommendation: Choose the unified runtime error-classification path or intentionally preserve local behavior, then remove duplicate imports and add provider error classification tests.

title: Anthropic provider contains parser-breaking merge conflict
description: The file conflicts between unified classifyError handling and local status-based retryability handling, with duplicate parseRetryAfterFromError imports.
impact: Provider package typecheck/build fails. Runtime retry/backoff behavior is ambiguous until the conflict is resolved.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict markers in Anthropic streaming error handling.
recommendation: Resolve toward one retry/error classification contract shared across providers, then add Anthropic provider error tests.

title: Supabase data-layer adapter contains realtime publish type conflict
description: The conflict differs on whether client.channel needs an unknown cast and whether subscribe/unsubscribe/send return unknown or Promise<unknown>. One branch documents Supabase subscribe as fire-and-forget.
impact: TypeScript parsing/build fails. Choosing the wrong branch can misrepresent the Supabase realtime API contract.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict markers in realtime publish typing.
recommendation: Resolve against the actual Supabase Realtime API contract and add a type-level regression test or compile fixture for the publish wrapper.

title: Chrome extension pageActions contains formatting merge conflict
description: The conflict is over one-line versus multi-line chaining for sensitive text redaction.
impact: Extension build/typecheck/lint fail due parser errors, even if the behavioral difference is likely none.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict marker at the sensitive text redaction chain.
recommendation: Resolve formatting conflict and run extension typecheck/lint/build.

title: Chrome extension panel contains formatting merge conflicts
description: The conflicts are formatting-only around disclosure banner promise formatting, return type formatting, and streamPrompt call wrapping.
impact: Extension build/typecheck/lint fail due parser errors.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict markers at panel.ts lines 229, 261, and 306.
recommendation: Resolve formatting conflicts and run extension typecheck/lint/build.

title: Device poll API route contains formatting merge conflicts
description: The conflicts are over multi-line versus single-line NextResponse.json Not Found responses.
impact: Next/web build and typecheck fail due parser errors. There is likely no behavioral difference after choosing either formatting branch.
evidence: Manual Wave 1 audit confirmed real conflict markers at route.ts lines 66 and 85.
recommendation: Resolve formatting conflicts and run web typecheck/build for the route.
